title: perf: three Pages test files each run their own full site build, in separate processes
problem: In platform/pages, build.test.mjs (298 s), build-determinism.test.mjs (292 s; two sequential buildSite calls) and custom-domain.test.mjs (120 s) each build the site themselves; every other file is under 10 s. Files run in parallel, so wall time is the max, but all three occupy cores at once and the Pages test step is the heaviest in the runner pool. CORRECTION 2026-11-04 (perf run): the per-file timings above were taken with no PAGES_CARD_CACHE, i.e. cold share-card drawing (~60% idle main thread waiting on the card worker pool). CI sets PAGES_CARD_CACHE for this step, so custom-domain is ~28 s warm (65 s on the first run that fills the cache, 120 s before), not 120 s. Part 2 as written (sharing one build between custom-domain and build.test) is not viable: custom-domain builds a fixture ventures dir with a different baseUrl.
evidence: per-file timing, 4-core sandbox, 2026-11-04: for f in *.test.mjs cloudflare/*.test.mjs; do node --test $f; done -> 64 files, all pass, sum 776 s; build 297.8, build-determinism 292.5, custom-domain 120.2, next largest surface-budget 8.8
